Blanco, Flora de Filipinas, Gran edicion, [Atlas I], plate 43 BIS
Lithographer imprint on the plate: "Lit. C. Verdaguer, Barcelona"
Date: 1880-1883 (Atlas I of the gran edicion; the text volumes are 1877-1883)

Caption, transcribed from the plate itself:
SOLANUM LYCOPERSICUM. - LINN. - De Blanco.
SOLANUM CERASIFORME. - DUN.
VAR. - BACCIS RUBRIS. - TOURN.

Plate number: "43 BIS" is printed in the upper right corner of the plate and is
what this file is named for. NOTE A DISCREPANCY: Merrill, Species Blancoanae
(1918), cites the same species as "ed. 3, 1 (1877) 176, t. 48". The plate's own
printed number is 43 bis. Cite the printed number, and flag the discrepancy if
the Merrill citation is used.
